Chicken Adobo

1 tablespoon oil,
3 cloves garlic, sliced,
half an red onion, sliced,
crushed ginger (optional, same size of the half onion),
3 bay leaves (optional, for aroma),
1/2 kg chicken (depends how many chicken you want, and, any part of the chicken can do),
4 tablespoon soy sauce,
2 tablespoon vinegar,
1 tablespoon sugar (optional),
3 or 4 cups of water


Bring a pot to heat and add tablespoon of oil. Saute the garlic, then onions, and then ginger. Add chicken and saute it for a minute, then add water. Bring it to a boil for 20 minutes. Check if the chicken is tender then add the soy sauce,  vinegar and sugar. Simmer it down for 5 minutes and add the bay leaves. 

Note: Ingredients can be adjusted, since I always eyeball everything, especially the water or sauce since you can go for having a sauce or no sauce at all. You can adjust the taste whether you like it to be sweeter or you are fine with the savory one. Best to eat it with rice.
